funds.description: All financial resources not accounted for and reported in another fund.
funds.label: General

funds.description: Proceeds of specific revenue sources restricted or committed to specified purposes other than debt service or capital projects.
funds.label: Special Revenue

funds.description: Resources restricted, committed or assigned to principal and interest.
funds.label: Debt Service

funds.description: Resources restricted, committed or assigned to capital outlays.
funds.label: Capital Projects

funds.description: Resources of which only earnings, not principal, may be used to support the government's programs.
funds.label: Permanent

funds.description: Operations financed and run like private businesses, with costs recovered mainly through user charges.
funds.label: Enterprise

funds.description: Goods or services provided by one department to other departments or governments on a cost-reimbursement basis.
funds.label: Internal Service

funds.description: Assets held in a purely custodial capacity, such as taxes collected for other governments. Reported from FY 2020-21 (GASB 84).
funds.label: Custodial

funds.description: Assets of pension and other employee benefit plans held in a trustee capacity.
funds.label: Pension

funds.description: Trust funds reported in EDR's Trust column (the UAS lists investment trust funds among the fiduciary funds).
funds.label: Trust

funds.description: Trust arrangements whose principal and income benefit individuals, private organizations or other governments.
funds.label: Private Purpose

funds.description: Legally separate organizations reported alongside the county in their own column.
funds.label: Component Units

note: Custodial amounts are controlled by the custodial toggle, so no preset lists the custodial fund.
